attributes.action: To build a multi storey car park at Shrewsbury NHS Hospital for parking issues
attributes.additional_details: To fund and build a multi-storey car park at the Shrewsbury NHS Hospital to solve parking issues.Since building the new buildings, there is less parking space available.There are many staff car parks and no ground space left.Patients care is being impacted.The answer is to build upwards and create layers of car parking space in a multi-storey car park.This will allow people to attend appointments and access the hospital effectively. Patients shouldn’t have to circle the hospital for hours on end
attributes.background:
insufficient hospital parking Causes patients to miss/arrive late for appointments.Creates unnecessary stress for vulnerable/elderly patients.Disadvantages people with disabilities and mobility difficulties.
Makes visiting seriously ill relatives more difficult.Creates difficulties for NHS staff.

rejection.details: This is a local matter which does not fall directly within the responsibility of the Government or of Parliament. It is materially a matter for the relevant NHS Trust. You may wish to contact your local MP about this.
